title: 3-minute recruiter demo
description: Four quick scenarios demonstrate grounded answers, permission boundaries, human review, and measurable reliability without external services or credentials.

steps.title: Grounded approval workflow
steps.question: What approvals are required before engaging a new vendor?
steps.expected: Cited policy evidence plus a controlled approval checklist.

steps.title: Permission-aware abstention
steps.question: What penetration testing evidence must a software vendor provide?
steps.expected: The employee view should refuse to reveal restricted Security evidence.

steps.title: Authorized evidence view
steps.question: What penetration testing evidence must a software vendor provide?
steps.expected: The Security role should receive the permitted restricted source.

steps.title: Reliability proof
steps.expected: Run the deterministic golden suite and inspect traceable checks.
